decisionEvents.ret: "So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it? That's my read."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. Take your time with it."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Hey." Ella settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? Ha."
"Can we talk?" Ella sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Look at me. This matters. Everything matters now, do you understand?"
"What do you miss most? From before."
"About what you miss most — What do you miss most? From before. Thank you. Really."
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. I need help. Please."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the meadow edge, west of the creek."
"What's this about? What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"Please — have you got anything to spare? Anything? My hands shake when I try to work."
"About what you miss most — What do you miss most? From before, friend."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the far treeline, past the rocks."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"About what scares you most — What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. Let's move."
"Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started. It'll keep."
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"Can we talk?" Catalina sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy. Just... be straight with me."
"Please — I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. Will you help me?"
"Please — tell me you've got food to spare. I'm past hungry here. I can't keep going like this."
"Can we talk?" Tomas sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"Please — I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. I need help. Please."
"I'm sorry — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Will you help me?"
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I said something cruel. I think about it every day."
"Listen to me — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I asked Heinrich about the food I needed — Heinrich's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I asked Heinrich about the sickness I'm fighting — Heinrich's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I hate to ask, but tell me you've got food to spare. I'm going hungry here. I can't keep going like this."
"Please — have you got anything to spare? Anything? I can't keep going like this."
"I'm sorry — I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. Will you help me?"
"About the food I needed — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About how this changed you — Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"About the food I needed — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
